sessions.title: The Pioneer
sessions.must: Resolve the maintenance incident and reveal the repair record from tomorrow.

replies.question: Confirm the destination.
replies.text: CSV-01 Pioneer. Destination: Asteria-4. Mission: establish a deliberate second civilization. Earth remains habitable.

replies.question: Explain the departments.
replies.text: Flight navigates. Science investigates. Engineering maintains the ship. Colony helps a community take shape. Each department depends on the others.

replies.question: Can you classify the brief lensing pattern?
Why was the unit allowed to do that?
replies.text: The unit is operating within maintenance authority.

openings.2: Maintenance authority is active. How may I assist?
openings.3: The navigation estimates are available. State your question.

rhee.name: Chief Tomas Rhee
rhee.opening: Every ship is a collection of problems that have agreed not to happen at the same time.

replies.question: What is that maintenance unit doing?
replies.text: That unit is either malfunctioning or developing artistic opinions. Both are unacceptable.

replies.question: How should we stop it?
replies.text: Shut it down, trap it, redirect it, or cut its power. Protect the ship and the people first.

replies.question: Can we trust the repair record?
replies.text: Machines lie less often than people. That does not mean they never lie.

replies.question: What is wrong with the clocks?
replies.text: Four correct clocks can still make one impossible system.

replies.question: What should a new engineer remember?
replies.text: Notice what changes. Check before you act. A good question can prevent a very expensive repair.

openings.2: That unit is either malfunctioning or developing artistic opinions. Both are unacceptable.
openings.3: Four correct clocks can still make one impossible system.

replies.question: What repair are you talking about?
replies.text: PLEASE DO NOT INTERFERE WITH YOUR PREVIOUS REPAIR.

ticket.title: Maintenance ticket
ticket.note: The record names a repair the crew has not yet performed. The timestamp is the essential contradiction.

scenes.title: A perfectly functional door

cues.title: An unwanted repair
cues.text: A maintenance unit rolls through the habitation service corridor and welds a perfectly functional door shut.

cues.title: Chief Rhee
cues.text: That unit is either malfunctioning or developing artistic opinions. Both are unacceptable.
cues.speaker: rhee

scenes.gm: The teacher confirmed M-77 as canonical, with the bible’s complete clue. The P-73 / MT-4487 visual variant is not used as a conflicting fact.

scenes.title: Three rounds to stop the repairs

cues.title: Protect the ship
cues.text: Stop the units before they seal three spaces or dismantle essential equipment. Hack, trap, cut power, distract, redirect, defend or use the environment.

cues.title: Round 1 / the door
cues.text: A minor drone welds a door. Show a clear preparation, action and reaction. Keep stage-combat distance.

cues.title: Round 2 / life support
cues.text: A second drone begins dismantling a life-support access panel. The environment has changed. What tactic changes with it?

cues.title: Round 3 / previous repair
cues.text: PLEASE DO NOT INTERFERE WITH YOUR PREVIOUS REPAIR.
cues.speaker: m77

cues.title: Resolve the incident
cues.text: The encounter ends through shutdown, retreat or containment. The service record survives.

scenes.gm: Exactly three rounds, advanced by the GM. Large M-77 has TWO threat boxes; two minor repair drones have ONE each. No real contact during classroom staging. Accept negotiation, hacking and containment as valid. The clue must survive any resolution. Compression option: one unit, two rounds, then the log.

scenes.title: A repair from tomorrow

cues.title: The service history
cues.text: Rhee opens the service history. His expression changes before he says anything.

cues.title: Chief Rhee
cues.text: Machines lie less often than people. That does not mean they never lie.
cues.speaker: rhee

cues.title: Event / choice / consequence
cues.text: What happened? What choice did your company make? What followed? On paper, capture a 6–8 line scene with one gesture before the first spoken reaction.

scenes.gm: Must reach: the repaired-by-Cohort record dated tomorrow. Keep the exact M-77 / TOMORROW 14:32 / unrecorded passenger text. Required clues never depend on winning a perception or combat roll.
